Pattaya and Bangkok Advise 2026 (From Paul's Trip)

Paul spent roughly a week in Pattaya followed by about 5 days in Bangkok. He focused on bars, go-go clubs, gentlemen's clubs, and Nuru-style massage places. He avoided using apps like TF on this trip.

Pattaya

Main places visited

  • Heaven Above (LK Metro): Went early on the first night (girls sitting, not dancing yet). Some attractive girls (rated around 8). Returned later and made eye contact with cuties, including one with very perky breasts, but another girl latched on.
  • Kink (LK Metro): Ground floor empty. Left quickly.
  • Soi 6: Walked the street multiple nights. Got a lot of attention (grabbed, pulled, etc.). Stopped at Corner Bar for a Chang beer (59 baht). At 3 Angels Bar a lively girl grabbed him. Bar fine 1500 baht. She charged nothing for long-time beyond 4 extra drinks (720 baht total). He still gave her 2000 baht. Another night at a different Soi 6 bar: fun time, but bar fine quoted at 2000 baht and short-time over 3000 baht (he found this steep).
  • Windmill (Soi Diamond): Mixed. Girls mostly 6-7. Fun atmosphere with girl-on-girl stage show, nearby shower show, and very handsy behavior. Tip: Sit where you can see both shows without turning your neck constantly.
  • XS (Walking Street): High-quality girls (several 8-10s, some stunners even late). Not his preferred scene due to richer customers competing.
  • Gentlemen's clubs on Soi Buakhao / Bong Koch 8: The Factory (disappointing, older women with visible wear). The Chapel (very poor selection, girls rated around 4 at best). He preferred mainstream places.
  • Nuru Spa Pattaya (Pattaya 3rd Road): Near his hotel. Paid 3000 baht for 1-hour soapy massage. Mamasan recommended a young girl with braces not on the daily list. Decent massage and good time overall.
  • Other notes: Planned Kings and Nuru House but details limited. Mentioned past good experiences at Maggie Mays and High Rollers. Last year visited Sabai Dee (fishbowl lineup with color-coded price tags; green for younger/prettier and more expensive). Advised picking a girl who smiles and shows interest rather than just the prettiest.

Advice from Pattaya

  • Soi 6 prices have risen (bar fine often 1000-2000, short-time 2000-3000, plus drink minimums). Long-time can offer better value at night. Short-time works better earlier in the day.
  • Treat girls with respect and be friendly. It leads to better experiences and memorable times, even if you are not young or especially good-looking.
  • Stunners can look great but sometimes give less enthusiastic service. Average-looking girls often provide better girlfriend experience.
  • For freelancers: Walking Street nightclubs after about 2 am (many bar girls go there after shifts).
  • Solo travel tip: Make friends with other travelers, expats, and staff. Return to the same places to build familiarity. Take a girl whenever you feel ready. No fixed schedule.
  • Gentlemen's clubs can be good value if you accept that many women are past their peak.

Bangkok

Main places visited

  • Freelancers: Common at night along Sukhumvit entertainment areas (fewer in daytime). Near Thermae many are ladyboys. Thermae itself still had a selection at midnight (MILFs to a few younger ones). One young woman opened at 3000 baht short-time (negotiable). Near Maison Hotel on Soi 4: decent-looking freelancers (online reports around 2000 baht or less).
  • Patpong / Japan Town: Visited several Kings go-go clubs (3 of the 4). Girls mostly light-skinned, tall, skinny, small butts, often bob haircuts. Attractive and not pushy (waving and eye contact only). Doors open to the night market so limited physical interaction. Nearby Thaniya Road has KTV options with pretty girls lined up (touts handle introductions; not his preference).
  • Soi Cowboy: Crazy House was a dud (unappealing girls). Avoided others due to a past scam experience. Noted Tilac and Baccara as longer-established and reliable.
  • Nana Plaza: Spanky's (very packed even in low season, standing room only one night. Harry Potter-themed show more funny than sexy. Connected with a cute girl but a loud whistling customer next to them ruined the mood). Angel Witch (poor selection and show - left quickly). Billboard (strong night: several 9-10s and 8s, friendly and flirty). Twisters BKK (quieter, girls around 7-8. One dark-haired girl gave a lap dance then offered short-time: bar fine 1000 baht, 2-hour short-time 4000 baht). Lollipop (1st floor): Avoid - staff very pushy about buying drinks for themselves and selecting girls.
  • Other bars: Angels Four (near hotel, Hilary group). One early MILF hostess already drunk. Later quieter with older hostesses. One drunk hostess flashed. Staff said Hilary 1 across the courtyard stays open until about 5 am and fills with women from Nana and elsewhere after 3 am.
  • Nuru / massage places:
    • J-Spot (Sukhumvit 33): 3500 baht for 1-hour Nuru. Mamasan recommended Papee ("do everything number one"). Cute face, larger enhanced breasts. Excellent service - went straight from shower to body-to-body and activity, skipping regular massage. Very satisfied.
    • Amor 888 (near Sukhumvit 18): 4-hands session, 6400 baht for 90 minutes. Mamasan upgraded to jacuzzi room and gave Kamagra. Girls Miso and Cherry (both very attractive). Full activity including shower, body-to-body, multiple rounds, tub, and massage. Focused only on him (no girl-girl interaction). Recommended. Same ownership group as J-Spot; both offered punch cards for other participating spas.
    • Qian Qian Nuru Spa (one block from his hotel): 4000 baht for 1 hour. Chose Soda (older, cute, some curves). Best overall spa experience of the trip - solid massage (hands and elbows), good activity, long bubble jacuzzi, ran overtime without complaint.
    • Past recommendation: Daisy Dream (next to J-Spot). Better ambiance and rooms than J-Spot, slight edge in girl looks. Equal service and price. Also recommended Amor 888 from prior trip. Mentioned another place with onsen-style tub (name forgotten).

Advice from Bangkok

  • Most bar and go-go activity is takeaway (to short-time hotel or your hotel). Rooms are rarely inside the bars.
  • Nana Plaza can be chaotic and packed. Some places (like Lollipop) have aggressive staff - leave if it ruins the mood.
  • For first-timers to Thailand overall, Pattaya is easier and more straightforward than Bangkok.
  • Nuru places vary by individual girl and day. Asking the mamasan for a recommendation can work well. Punch cards exist at some (J-Spot, Amor) linking multiple spas.
  • Hotels in Thailand are generally relaxed about guests.
